{{Top|leg}}
In the culture of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], a '''familiar''' was an attendant [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit]] in animal form. It could be summoned by using a [[Totem of Familiars]]. This conjured beast was blessed with [[Dathomir Magic|magick]] and would remain with the crafter as they possessed the totem.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The familiars of the Nightsisters were inspired by the folk-belief of the Medieval period known as [[Wikipedia:Familiar spirit|familiar spirits]].<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 4)}}</ref>
